definitions.station: First positive reachability.reachable; center target only, within 0.10 m.
definitions.arrival: First actual saved ball center crossing moving actual robot center X plane, using linear interpolation between 1 ms samples.
definitions.censor: If physical robot contact occurs before center-plane crossing, no post-contact robot pose is combined with an absent-ball future. Station endpoint and full-before-deadline entry scores are null; pre-contact entry evidence remains descriptive.
definitions.body_coverage: Native current/translated frozen pose overlap hypothesis, not future gait shape or an implemented reach/jump/dive.
definitions.interception: G intercept_feasible is distinct from station_reachable and current/target/decision_body_coverage.
definitions.operational_false_positive: At least one pre-contact intercept_feasible=True, followed by completed contact miss or completed block miss against an absent right goal, counted separately.
definitions.F_comparison: F station-positive/contact or block misses are reported separately and never relabeled as a historical interception promise.
definitions.position: F/G permanent tolerance hold is the saved F metric; stop times are last moving raw sample, bursts start one post-step sample after decisions.

minimal_recommendations: Keep center-station feasibility, native body coverage and physical interception/block outcomes as separate reported quantities.
Use uncensored real robot-plane deadlines to audit center arrival; mark contacted trajectories censored instead of scoring invented post-contact counterfactual poses.
Treat operational false positives as empirical calibration observations for this declared protocol, not universal success-rate estimates.
